output.text: The library book club met on a rainy Thursday evening, and everyone arrived within a few minutes of each other. Assume that Milo is the club secretary. Otto arrived first, carrying a stack of paperbacks he wanted to trade with the group. Kira came in shortly after, laughing about the weather and shaking out her umbrella by the door. Noor booked the hall. Jude showed up last, slightly out of breath from rushing across campus after a late seminar. Milo had already picked seats near the window, arranging chairs so everyone could see the display of new arrivals. Otto is in the same class as Kira. The two of them often walk to the library together after lectures end. Noor mentioned she had chosen a mystery novel for next month, and Milo nodded approvingly at the suggestion. Kira is not in the same class as Jude. Jude, meanwhile, was still talking about the seminar, describing an argument that had run long past its scheduled time. Otto is not in the same class as Jude. Milo passed around a sign-up sheet for the next meeting, and Kira signed first, followed by Otto. Noor is the tallest of the group, though Jude insists he is only an inch shorter. Milo is younger than Otto but older than Kira, at least according to the birthday cake they shared last spring. The club agreed to meet again in three weeks, once the new books had arrived and everyone had time to read them.
